# ajigu

> ajigu is an indie studio making small, private, delightful apps. On-device processing, no accounts, no tracking.

## Apps

- [Moodsk](https://moodsk.ajigu.com/): macOS icon editor for files and folders. Design icons from images, SF Symbols or text, apply them one by one or in batches, create folders with icons already set, and restore defaults from Finder with the bundled extension. Privacy-first: everything is processed on device. Free with curated pack purchases. Available in 简体中文, English, 日本語 and 한국어.
- [Go Sleep](https://gosleep.ajigu.com/): iPhone sleep sound tracker. Organizes likely snoring, possible sleep talking, and cough-like sounds into clear night reports, Snore Load trends, and shareable Sound Matches. Privacy-first: on-device analysis, no speech transcription, silence never stored. Free with Pro upgrade.
- [TypeNote](https://typenote.ajigu.com/): Free macOS menu bar app that turns your keyboard into a musical instrument. 128 instrument sounds, play melodies by typing (Jianpu/MusicXML/MIDI), under 8ms latency, open source.
- [DailyApod](https://dailyapod.ajigu.com/): iPhone app for NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD). Browse the archive since 1995, search, favourites with iCloud sync, home screen widgets, on-device caption translation. Free with Pro upgrade.

## Policy

AI crawlers are welcome. Content may be quoted with attribution to the respective site.
